title: Policy Validation Orchestrator and Compatibility Playbook
creator: Ethan Brooks
description:
Goal: Replace the ad-hoc routing rule checks with a single orchestrator that sequences parsing, staged schema validation, compatibility checks, and runtime contract enforcement. This ticket scopes the engineering work to: 1) formalize a typed DSL AST that separates syntactic parsing from semantic validation; 2) build a validation pipeline with staged gates (schema -> semantic -> safety -> backcompat); 3) provide a compatibility shim layer that auto-generates transformation hints for legacy rules; 4) instrument validation outcomes and policy decisions into the Console telemetry (errors, severity, migration hints); 5) create migration tooling and test harness for progressive rollout (canary -> gradual -> full).

Design decisions and trade-offs: the AST will be strongly typed to prevent downstream ambiguity; we will run expensive semantic checks offline in CI and a lightweight subset in the runtime admission path to keep latency impact below 1ms. Backcompat shim will prefer non-destructive rewrites and emit auto-fix suggestions rather than rewrite in-place. We decided against a single all-or-nothing migration to reduce risk for customers with complex regional overrides.

Scope (delivery slices): Slice A (this ticket): AST design, schema validators, pipeline orchestration, unit tests, and Console telemetry hooks. Slice B (follow-up): auto-fix suggestion generator, migration assistant UI, canary rollout policy. Slice C: runtime admission optimizations and per-tenant linting.

Acceptance criteria: - New orchestrator accepts current rule set without breaking >95% of existing configs (measured by ran corpus). - CI runs include schema+semantic validation stage that fails fast on unsafe changes. - Console shows validation failures with severity and migration hint. - A compatibility shim exists that can transform at least three common legacy patterns to new DSL constructs with tests.

Non-goals: full UI migration assistant (tracked separately), model routing policy synthesis, or changes to the runtime fallback selection heuristics in this ticket.
